name: complete-claude-guide-for-product-managers-pack
description: 42 Claude Skills for the whole product job, stage by stage, from the vision to the weekly update: product vision and strategy, impact maps, market sizing, the lean canvas, north star metrics and roadmaps; customer interview guides, interview synthesis, personas, journey maps, jobs to be done, the value proposition canvas and the opportunity solution tree; feature request triage, RICE, ICE and WSJF scoring, cost of delay, business cases, DACI decisions and decision logs; one-pagers, PR/FAQs, prototype briefs, PRDs and AI feature specs; story maps, user stories, sprint planning, sprint reviews and MoSCoW scope cuts; competitive analysis, go-to-market plans, pre-mortems and release notes; success metrics, experiment design and post-launch reviews; plus the weekly update, the retro and the quarter plan. Each skill keeps one framework, with the inputs it needs, where it breaks, a fixed output template and the next skill to run.
